question: Which keyboard shortcut is used in MS PowerPoint 365 to start editing text inside a selected shape or text box
solution:
The correct answer is option 3,

The correct answer is __**F2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **F2** is the default keyboard shortcut in MS PowerPoint 365 to start editing text inside a selected shape or text box.
 
• When a shape or text box is selected, pressing F2 directly activates the editing mode, allowing users to modify the text content.
 
• This shortcut is specifically designed for convenience and saves time compared to manually double-clicking on the shape or text box.
 
• F2 is widely recognized across different versions of PowerPoint, making it a universal shortcut for text editing.
 
• Using keyboard shortcuts like F2 significantly enhances productivity and workflow efficiency while working with presentations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Keyboard Shortcuts in MS PowerPoint:**

 
 
• **Ctrl + M:** Adds a new slide to the presentation.
 
• **Ctrl + D:** Duplicates the selected slide.
 
• **Alt + Shift + Up/Down Arrow:** Moves slides up or down in the slide order.
 
• **Ctrl + P:** Activates the pen tool while presenting in slideshow mode.
 
• **Ctrl + Z:** Undoes the last action.
 
 
 
• **Text Editing in PowerPoint:**
 
 
• Text boxes and shapes are primary tools for adding content to slides.
 
• Double-clicking or using F2 allows users to quickly access the text-editing mode.
 
• Formatting options like font size, color, and alignment can be adjusted using the toolbar or ribbon.
 
• Keyboard shortcuts like Ctrl + B (bold) and Ctrl + I (italic) enhance text formatting efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Productivity Benefits of Shortcuts:**
 
 
• Keyboard shortcuts streamline workflows by reducing dependency on mouse navigation.
 
• They help users perform repetitive tasks faster, enhancing overall productivity.
 
• Memorizing key shortcuts can significantly improve presentation creation time.
 
 
 
• **PowerPoint Versions:**
 
 
• MS PowerPoint 365 is the latest subscription-based version, offering regular updates and cloud-based features.
 
• Older versions like PowerPoint 2016 and PowerPoint 2019 support many of the same shortcuts.
 
• Shortcuts remain consistent across versions, ensuring ease of use for long-time users.
